discovery_gate.notes_for_user: macOS menu-bar app + embedded frameworks; already-selected profiles keep. New concern detections are mostly weak/doc-only cues; only persistence (ClipboardPersistence.swift/ClipboardKeyStore.swift + migrations docs) has real code evidence and unlocks the persistence document. Notifications/background-processing match AppKit/NSWorkspace observer APIs and SwiftUI .background() modifiers (false positives); payments explicitly not used (StoreKit absent); analytics has no SDK in code; offline-sync is doc prose ('core is offline').
